title: HB347 (87th Legislature Regular Session): Relating to a false statement made to illegally acquire a firearm; creating a criminal offense.
operative_text:
Sec. 1 (amending Penal Code 46.06(a)): (6) knowingly purchases, rents, leases, or receives as a loan or gift from another a handgun while an active protective order is directed to the actor{+; or+} {+(7)+}{+ +}{+ +}{+while prohibited from possessing a firearm under +} {+state or federal law, knowingly makes a material false statement on +} {+a form that is:+} {+(A)+}{+ +}{+ +}{+required by state or federal law for the +} {+purchase, sale, or other transfer of a firearm; and+} {+(B)+}{+ +}{+ +}{+submitted to a licensed firearms dealer, as +} {+defined by 18 U.S.C. Section 923+}.
Sec. 1 (amending Penal Code 46.06(d)): (d) An offense under this section is a Class A misdemeanor, except that{+:+} {+(1)+} an offense under Subsection (a)(2) is a state jail felony if the weapon that is the subject of the offense is a handgun{+; and+} {+(2)+}{+ +}{+ +}{+an offense under Subsection (a)(7) is a state jail +} {+felony+}.
